title: Shiva Meal Planner V2 — Full Redesign
body:
## Summary
- Complete redesign of shiva meal planner (organizer wizard, volunteer view, organizer dashboard)
- Grief-friendly, mobile-first UX (20px+ fonts, 48px+ tap targets, Meal Train-level simplicity)
- Multiple groups per meal slot, walk-in logging, family search dedup
- V7 schema migration (additive only — no breaking changes)
- Obituary dedup strategy researched (Phase 6 — not yet implemented)

## What's done (Phases 1-4)
- [x] Schema: 15 new columns, family search endpoint, multi-signup support
- [x] Organizer wizard: 4-step flow + quick setup mode
- [x] Volunteer view: calendar grid + signup modal
- [x] Organizer dashboard: coverage, walk-ins, edit, contact list, archive
- [x] 25 unit tests passing
- [x] Integration tested locally

## Still needed before merge
- [ ] Phase 5: Notification system (signup alerts, day-before reminders)
- [ ] Phase 6: Obituary deduplication
- [ ] Phase 7: ICS calendar download
- [ ] Phase 8: Playwright E2E tests
- [ ] Full staging QA
- [ ] Deploy after April 9, 10PM-6AM ET only

## DO NOT MERGE until after April 9 (Amanda's shiva ends)
